Wrong warthead&mdash;Great Bogga is ''crime boss'' of the Stenness worlds&mdash;and he's going to be really ''pleased'' to meet ''you''!|[[Finhead Stonebone]] and [[Grimorg]]|<ref name="TOTJ4">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Aweris system''',<ref name="TOTJC" /> later known as the '''Taboon system''',<ref name="TEA" /> was located along the border of the [[Stenness Node]]. It centered around the yellow [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Awer]], which was orbited by the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Taboon]].
